test_title: PYST 01: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that gives the most appropriate meaning of the underlined word.

Even amidst the all-pervasive silence, the noise inside her head seemed __incessant.__

options.text: To impact in a strikingly negative way
To occur at irregular intervals or occasionally

solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 2'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**incessant**" means continuing without any interruption, which fits the context of the sentence.
 
• Other options do not fit as accurately. For example, "To follow an unknown course" does not describe the nature of the noise.
 
• "To impact in a strikingly negative way" and "To occur at irregular intervals or occasionally" also do not match the continuous nature implied by "incessant".

Hence, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Correct Sentence***: Even amidst the all-pervasive silence, the noise inside her head seemed incessant.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "To follow an unknown course" does not describe the nature of "incessant".
 
• **Option 3:** "To impact in a strikingly negative way" does not fit the context of continuous noise.
 
• **Option 4:** "To occur at irregular intervals or occasionally" contradicts the meaning of "incessant".
